title: The Example of Christ, Paul's Ministry to the Gentiles, Paul's Plan to Visit Rome

questions.question: We who are strong have an obligation to bear with the failings of the weak, and not to please ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 15:1 (ESV): "We who are strong have an obligation to bear with the failings of the weak, and not to please ourselves."

questions.question: For Christ did not please himself, but as it is written, "The reproaches of those who reproached you ____."
questions.explanation: Romans 15:3 (ESV): "For Christ did not please himself, but as it is written, 'The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.'"

questions.question: Whatever was written in former days was written for our ____, that through endurance and through the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
questions.explanation: Romans 15:4 (ESV): "For whatever was written in former days was written for our instruction, that through endurance and through the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope."

questions.question: May the God of endurance and encouragement grant you to live in such harmony with one another, in accord with Christ Jesus, that together you may with one voice glorify who?
options: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ
questions.correctAnswer: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ
questions.explanation: Romans 15:5-6 (ESV): "May the God of endurance and encouragement grant you to live in such harmony with one another, in accord with Christ Jesus, that together you may with one voice glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ."

questions.question: Therefore welcome one another as Christ has welcomed you, for the ____ of God.
questions.explanation: Romans 15:7 (ESV): "Therefore welcome one another as Christ has welcomed you, for the glory of God."

questions.question: Paul says Christ became a servant to the circumcised to show God's truthfulness, in order to confirm what?
options: The promises given to the patriarchs
questions.correctAnswer: The promises given to the patriarchs
questions.explanation: Romans 15:8 (ESV): "For I tell you that Christ became a servant to the circumcised to show God's truthfulness, in order to confirm the promises given to the patriarchs,"

questions.question: May the God of hope fill you with all ____ in believing, so that by the power of the Holy Spirit you may abound in hope.
questions.explanation: Romans 15:13 (ESV): "May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, so that by the power of the Holy Spirit you may abound in hope."

questions.question: Paul writes that he is satisfied that the Roman believers are full of ____, filled with all knowledge and able to instruct one another.
questions.explanation: Romans 15:14 (ESV): "I myself am satisfied about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge and able to instruct one another."

questions.question: Paul describes his calling as a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles in the priestly service of the gospel of God, so that the offering of the Gentiles may be ____.
options: acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit
questions.correctAnswer: acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit
questions.explanation: Romans 15:16 (ESV): "to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles in the priestly service of the gospel of God, so that the offering of the Gentiles may be acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit."

questions.question: Paul says he will not venture to speak of anything except what Christ has accomplished through him to bring the Gentiles to obedience. By what does he say this was accompanied?
options: By the power of signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God
By the laying on of hands and impartation of gifts
By great suffering and affliction in every city
By the preaching of the law and the prophets
questions.correctAnswer: By the power of signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God
questions.explanation: Romans 15:18-19 (ESV): "For I will not venture to speak of anything except what Christ has accomplished through me to bring the Gentiles to obedience—by word and deed, by the power of signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God..."

questions.question: Paul made it his ambition to preach the gospel, not where Christ has already been named, lest he ____.
options: reap what he had not sown
questions.explanation: Romans 15:20 (ESV): "and thus I make it my ambition to preach the gospel, not where Christ has already been named, lest I build on someone else's foundation,"

questions.question: Paul hopes to see the Romans in passing as he goes to what region?
questions.explanation: Romans 15:24 (ESV): "I hope to see you in passing as I go to Spain, and to be helped on my journey there by you, once I have enjoyed your company for a while."

questions.question: Before visiting Rome, Paul must first go to Jerusalem, bringing aid to the saints. Who had been pleased to make some contribution for the poor among the saints at Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Romans 15:26 (ESV): "For Macedonia and Achaia have been pleased to make some contribution for the poor among the saints at Jerusalem."

questions.question: Paul explains that the Gentiles owe it to the Jewish believers to minister to them in material blessings because the Gentiles have come to share in their ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 15:27 (ESV): "For they were pleased to do it, and indeed they owe it to them. For if the Gentiles have come to share in their spiritual blessings, they ought also to be of service to them in material blessings."

questions.question: Paul appeals to the brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, to strive together with him in what?
options: In your prayers to God on my behalf
In the spread of the gospel to the ends of the earth
In maintaining the unity of the Spirit
In suffering for the sake of the Name
questions.correctAnswer: In your prayers to God on my behalf
questions.explanation: Romans 15:30 (ESV): "I appeal to you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, to strive together with me in your prayers to God on my behalf,"

key_verse_text: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, so that by the power of the Holy Spirit you may abound in hope.
